note: The Fair Meadow's description, seen on arrival, says only Barnaby and Clementine signed for Sparkle Blue, giving away the paint-sheet clue before it is found.

patch.value: A bright meadow full of striped tents and lantern strings. A big stage stands at one end. A sparkly blue table waits for the treasures.

A bright meadow full of striped tents and lantern strings. A big stage stands at one end. A sparkly blue table waits for the treasures. By the paint pots, a sheet shows that only Barnaby and Clementine signed for Sparkle Blue.
